...WIND ADVISORY IN EFFECT FROM NOON SATURDAY TO 1 AM EDT SUNDAY...

* WHAT...Northeast winds 15 to 25 mph with gusts up to 40 mph
  expected.

* WHERE...In Florida, Coastal Duval, Coastal Flagler, Coastal Nassau,
  Inland Flagler, Northeast Coastal St. Johns, Northern Inland St.
  Johns, Southeast Coastal St. Johns, and Southern Inland St. Johns
  Counties. In Georgia, Coastal Camden and Coastal Glynn Counties.

* WHEN...From noon Saturday to 1 AM EDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
  limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

PRECAUTIONARY/PREPAREDNESS ACTIONS...

Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

Secure outdoor objects including decorations.
